The proof for nonincreasing sequences bounded from below is similar.

It is important to realize that Theorem 6 does not say that convergent sequences are monotonic. The sequence 5(-1)n+1>n6 converges and is bounded, but it is not monotonic since it alternates between positive and negative values as it tends toward zero. What the theorem does say is that a nondecreasing sequence converges when it is bounded from above, but it diverges to infinity otherwise.
